title: Exhibit I: drafted sketch of 8-ft silver dome with dark cable and canister
description: Line drawing labeled "EXHIBIT I" showing a shallow silver dome or parachute-like canopy dimensioned "8'" wide, connected by an angled line labeled "DARK CABLE" (dimension marked 5) to a rectangular body labeled "BALL OR A CANISTER" and "SILVER". The page bears a faint CONFIDENTIAL stamp and handwritten page number 39.
